description: Source code for stock management in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including classes for stock locations, incoterms, stock tracking, and stock pickings.

classes.name: stock_incoterms
classes.description: Model for Incoterms, defining name, code, and active status.

classes.name: stock_location
classes.description: Model for stock locations, including hierarchy, stock quantities, and location details.

classes.name: stock_tracking
classes.description: Model for stock lot tracking, including SSCC checksum generation.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Model for stock pickings (delivery/receipt documents), managing states, dates, and move lines.

methods.name: _complete_name
methods.description: Computes full hierarchical name of a location.

methods.name: _product_qty_available
methods.description: Calculates available stock quantities for locations.

methods.name: product_detail
methods.description: Calculates total value of products in a location.

methods.name: _product_value
methods.description: Computes stock value for specified fields.

methods.name: chained_location_get
methods.description: Determines chained location based on location type.

methods.name: picking_type_get
methods.description: Determines picking type based on source and destination locations.

methods.name: get_min_max_date
methods.description: Retrieves min and max planned dates for pickings.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms a stock picking and its moves.

methods.name: action_assign
methods.description: Assigns stock moves in a picking.

methods.name: force_assign
methods.description: Forcefully assigns stock moves and triggers workflow.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a stock picking and its moves.

methods.name: action_move
methods.description: Completes move actions for a picking.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches stock tracking lots by serial or name.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display name for stock lots.

methods.name: make_sscc
methods.description: Generates SSCC barcode with checksum for stock lot.
